transcript: I just built this full multiplayer Attack on Titan game inside of Claude code, and it only took me about an hour and $31. All I did was ask Claude to build me an Attack on Titan in Minecraft, and it came back with a full game where you either play as a Survey Corps soldier cutting down Titans, or as one of the Titans themselves smashing through the wall. It's built fully in JavaScript, runs straight from the browser, and I didn't have to write a single line of code. Then, I asked it to add multiplayer through a Twilio relay so people from around the world can jump in and play together, and there are already hundreds, if not thousands, of players in there right now. So if you want the full guide on how to build a game like this, or you want to try it yourself, just comment Titan down below, and I'll send you the link directly.
